lesson: Checkpoint selection should prefer held-out generalization and calibrated failure behavior over later-step confidence magnitude.
reusable_rule: When two checkpoints tie on target correctness, prefer the one with lower regression and lower wrong-answer confidence.

lesson: A semantic checkpoint can be ratified as a substrate without declaring the full product model complete.
reusable_rule: Name partial promotion boundaries precisely: semantic base, structured-state branch, fusion, and identity adaptation are separate capability decisions.

lesson: Interactive latency must be measured with a resident model and realistic candidate count rather than model-load time.
reusable_rule: Keep cold load separate from warm interactive SLO evidence.

lesson: Typed structured state should preserve order robustness without flattening fields into prompt text.
reusable_rule: Use type/provenance/relation/temporal/missingness channels with no positional embeddings when field order is not semantic.

lesson: Specialist branches should start much smaller than the semantic core and scale only after a measured bottleneck.
reusable_rule: Keep new capability branches parameter-bounded and latency-aware by default.

lesson: The anti-MC10D rule applies after a successful checkpoint decision: move into the next missing model capability instead of opening another validation program.
reusable_rule: Validation should terminate in a capability decision and hand off immediately to model/data work.
